svg.title: Step 7: restore from a snapshot
svg.desc: A dashed frame holds a camera icon, the snapshot, and a small padlocked box with a teal square-headed key and a passkey badge stored beside it. An arrow leads to a machine whose safe door carries a red closed padlock, labelled Vault closed; a small pair shows a red closed padlock, an arrow and a green open padlock labelled Vault open. The admin confirms Restore with a fingerprint on a phone that carries a passkey badge. A dashed arrow carries the encrypted copy from the box to the phone. Another arrow leads from the phone to the machine, where a dashed gold round-headed key appears beside the vault. A dashed side panel shows the cream envelope with the words No passkey, use the package.
